name: The Marsh Shrine
description: Pale mangroves standing in a ring, and something at the centre that is not a tree.
arrival: The Kia did not build the shrine so much as agree about it. A ring of ghost mangrove, a stone with a hollow worn into the top, and a great deal of water that is shallower than it looks if you know where to put your feet.
notes: Kia rather than Harappan. Where the channel discovery is learned and the marsh-lurker can be watched.
